note: Glaze 1.0.39: choosing a theme now puts its widget art in place straight away. Use this theme (or any theme choice) downloads the theme if needed and fills Artwork 1-5. The Widgets tab shows Preparing, then the pieces, with no need for Use everything or a Home Screen widget first. A slot never shows the same artwork twice: a theme still waiting for new art shows a calm design in its colours there. Every artwork in My widget art has a menu to Save to Photos or Add to Custom 1-5, and the theme page notes that every theme comes with its own five artworks.
